title: Internationalized rule-pack messages + docs
context: A future-backlog task to lower the barrier for non-English-speaking citizen-science projects by internationalizing rule-pack messages and docs. The target language set is not yet enumerated and depends on partner/community demand, so this is a representative task; concrete per-language items expand once a language set is confirmed. Translations stay source-compatible and never relicense copyrighted source.
objective: Internationalize rule-pack messages and core docs, establishing the i18n message catalog and translation workflow for a to-be-confirmed set of languages.
acceptanceCriteria: Rule-pack messages and core docs externalized into an i18n message catalog
Translation workflow documented; at least one non-English locale provided as a reference
Translations are source-compatible and preserve technical accuracy (rule semantics unchanged)
Per-language items expand once a concrete language set is confirmed with partners/community
output: A PR adding the i18n message catalog, translation workflow docs, and at least one reference non-English locale for rule-pack messages and docs.
outputLicense: CC-BY-4.0 (translations source-compatible; never relicense copyrighted source)
